obligations.source_text: Independently create and render-test one complex still-frame interpretation of a living person's downward journey from the ordinary world into a visible realm of the dead, using the supplied portrait only as bounded visible face-and-hair appearance reference.

bindings.living_phrase: One traveler shows breath warm color active grip or another explicit sign of living agency: her flushed skin, condensed breath, and firm astrolabe grip.
bindings.origin_phrase: Daylight vegetation settlement or another human-world cue remains behind the traveler: a taut red cord leads continuously up to the daylight opening.
bindings.threshold_phrase: Stairs slope gate or river crossing establishes a directional descent across a boundary: her two boots straddle the carved basalt gate on descending treads.
bindings.destination_phrase: A distinct chthonic realm lies below or beyond the crossed threshold, with skeletal inhabitants, a hooded ferryman, and a black subterranean river.
bindings.purpose_phrase: A named objective guide token retrieval object or mission cue travels with the living visitor: her glowing astrolabe points toward the ferryman's drowned-city map tablet.
